steps: Create a model-local virtual environment with Python 3.10.
Install the minimal dependency set required for wespeaker.load_model(...).compute_similarity(...).
Install the local upstream repository in editable mode without dependency resolution.
Set WESPEAKER_HOME to the model-local checkpoints directory.
Validate import, load, infer, and contract on the tiny speaker-verification fixtures.
known_risks: The validated runtime depends on two existing lazy-import upstream patches.
The local english checkpoint archive must be available if config.yaml needs to be restored.
Fresh setup from zero requires network access to PyPI unless a compatible local wheel cache is already populated.
